name: Heroku Enterprise Usage Tracker
description: Production-grade usage tracking, license management, and intelligent notification system for Heroku Enterprise Accounts. Monitor resource utilization, receive smart alerts, and manage licensed capacity across multiple enterprise accounts.

APP_SESSION_SECRET.description: Secure random string for session encryption (auto-generated)

APP_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Admin username for dashboard login (stored in config vars for security)

APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password - CHANGE THIS IMMEDIATELY after deployment. Additional users can be created by admin in the UI.

HEROKU_API_TOKEN.description: Heroku OAuth token with billing access to enterprise accounts (get from: https://dashboard.heroku.com/account/applications)

MAILGUN_API_KEY.description: Mailgun API key for email notifications (get from: https://app.mailgun.com/app/account/security/api_keys)

MAILGUN_SMTP_SERVER.description: SMTP server for email fallback (default: smtp.mailgun.org)

CORS_ORIGIN.description: CORS origin for API requests (optional - auto-configured)

LOG_ALL_QUERIES.description: Log all database queries for debugging (default: false - only logs slow queries)
